description: Repeating an input of NAND or NOR expresses its negation; NAND of the repeated-input negations expresses disjunction, and NOR of them expresses conjunction.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.single_gate_identities.{u} {α : Type u} (k : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GateKind)
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α) (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SingleGateFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateNeg A) =
      !Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v A ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateConj k A B) =
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v A && Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v B) ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateDisj k A B) =
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v A || Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v B)
